record.field:
Receiving Inspection
Inventory and inspect all trays to the following creteria:
A: Aging or markinig of tray that leaves the tray 2 to 3 shades darker than other clear trays.
B. Cracks, chips or breakage: Any crackls in the tray body, or chips along the edge of the tray.
C. Scratches: Any gross visable scratches on the tray. Minor hairline scratches are acceptable.
D. Cluudy areas larger than a dime.
E. Warped: Any trays that appear to be warped, (all four corners should lay flat on a table), or center is bowed like a bowl (shoudl be "flat").
F. Residue: Trays found with stickers, labels and tape.
G. Any other obvious abnormality
For trays that have markings made with a permanent marker:
a Sort and process seperately
B. Reject at post cleaning final inspection if marks are still present.
Trays with missing support tabe:
a. Replace all damaged or missing support tabs with tabs from rejected trays if available.
B. When no tabs are available for replacement, reject as above with BKM sticker, Return to customer.

For trays that have markings made with a permanent marker:
a Sort and process seperately
B. Reject at post cleaning final inspection if marks are still present.
Trays with missing support tabe:
a. Replace all damaged or missing support tabs with tabs from rejected trays if available.
B. When no tabs are available for replacement, reject as above with BKM sticker, Return to customer.
